players.product: trapped-ion quantum computers (Forte, Forte Enterprise) sold as systems and as cloud access, plus quantum networking, sensing and security products

quarterly_data.signal: IonQ 8-K: on October 9, 2026 IonQ agreed to acquire Elisity, a Zero Trust security company with more than 100 global customer deployments, in an all-stock transaction expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026, pairing Elisity's platform with IonQ's post-quantum cryptography and quantum key distribution. IonQ says it has deployed some of the largest quantum-safe national communications networks, including in Switzerland, Poland, Romania and Slovakia, and delivered 40% year-over-year growth in multiproduct revenue in the second quarter of 2026. CEO Niccolo de Masi: 'Q-Day is coming much faster than predicted.'
quarterly_data.figure: more than 100 customer deployments; multiproduct revenue +40% (Q2 2026)
